model_organism.citation: Ji et al. 2018 - Poly(C)-Binding Protein Pcbp2 Enables Differentiation of Definitive Erythropoiesis by Directing Functional Splicing of the Runx1 Transcript (PMID: 29866654)
phenotypes: selective deficiency of the definitive erythroid lineage in Pcbp2-/- embryos
aberrant exclusion of Runx1 cassette exon 6 in the embryonic liver
Runx1ΔE6 homozygous embryos phenocopy the loss of the definitive erythroid lineage

model_organism.citation: Zhang et al. 2016 - RNA-binding Protein PCBP2 Regulates p73 Expression and p73-dependent Antioxidant Defense (PMID: 26907686)
phenotypes: PCBP2-deficient mice and primary MEFs show decreased p73 expression
increased ROS production in PCBP2-deficient MEFs
accelerated cellular senescence in PCBP2-deficient MEFs

model_organism.citation: RNA-binding protein PCBP2 regulates pancreatic β cell function and adaptation to glucose (PMID: 38950317)
phenotypes: Pcbp2-deficient β cells show impaired insulin secretion and adaptation to glucose
altered expression of mRNAs encoding insulin secretory pathway components
defects in calcium flux
abnormal insulin granule ultrastructure and exocytosis
defective amplification pathway of insulin secretion

model_organism.citation: RNA binding proteins PCBP1 and PCBP2 regulate pancreatic β cell translation (PMID: 40451383)
phenotypes: β cell-specific Pcbp1 deletion alone preserved glucose homeostasis
Pcbp1/2 β cell co-deletion caused severe diabetes due to compromised β cell viability
downregulation of translation initiation factor and ribosomal mRNAs in co-deficient β cells
reduced global mRNA translation

model_organism.citation: Iron chaperones and RNA-binding proteins, PCBP1 and PCBP2, maintain hepatic iron balance and protect against ferroptosis (PMID: 42379276)
phenotypes: Alb-Cre PCBP1/PCBP2 double deletion caused chronic severe hepatic injury with steatosis, necrosis and ductular reaction
increased plasma ALT and ALP
Nrf2-dependent antioxidant gene activation
AAV8-iCre double deletion in adult mice caused acute liver injury with periportal inflammation, apoptosis and DNA damage
ferroptosis-like injury with lipid peroxidation and 8-oxoguanine nucleic acid modifications
single PCBP2 deletion caused mild or no acute liver abnormalities (functional redundancy)
dietary iron restriction improved liver pathology

model_organism.citation: Role of PCBP2 in regulating nanovesicles loaded with curcumin to mitigate neuroferroptosis in neural damage caused by heat stroke (PMID: 39731111)
phenotypes: PCBP2 silencing reversed the protective effect of NVs-CUR on hypothalamic neural injury in the heat stroke model
reduced survival and worsened nerve function deficit scores
increased ferroptosis and reduced SLC7A11 mRNA stability

model_organism.citation: Silencing PCBP2 normalizes desmoplastic stroma and improves the antitumor activity of chemotherapy in pancreatic cancer (PMID: 33500719)
phenotypes: PCBP2 siRNA nanocomplex reduced type I collagen and ECM production in stellate cells and NIH 3T3 fibroblasts
enhanced drug penetration through desmoplastic stroma
combined with gemcitabine, suppressed tumor progression in an orthotopic PDAC mouse model

model_organism.citation: PCBP2 stabilizes TROAP to promote the malignant progression of gastric cancer (PMID: 39586843)
phenotypes: PCBP2 knockdown repressed tumor growth of gastric cancer cells in a subcutaneous xenograft mouse model

biological.citation: Wang et al. 2012 - Iron homeostasis regulates the activity of the microRNA pathway through poly(C)-binding protein 2 (PMID: 22633452)
biological.summary: PCBP2 associates with Dicer and promotes processing of miRNA precursors. Cytosolic iron modulates PCBP2-Dicer association, PCBP2 multimerization and its binding to pre-miRNAs, so PCBP2 links iron homeostasis to miRNA biogenesis. Iron chelators activate the miRNA pathway.

biological.citation: FAST-iCLIP 2014 - Dissecting noncoding and pathogen RNA-protein interactomes (PMID: 25411354)
biological.summary: FAST-iCLIP of PCBP2 showed it binds CU-rich motifs in different topologies on mRNAs and noncoding RNAs with distinct biological functions. In HCV-infected cells it also mapped PCBP2 interactions with host and viral RNAs.

biological.citation: Iron drives protease-independent cleavage of gasdermin D in allergic airway diseases (PMID: 42361797)
biological.summary: PCBP2 acts as an iron chaperone that delivers iron directly to GSDMD. This triggers a localized Fenton reaction whose hydroxyl radicals cleave GSDMD to the active p40 fragment, enabling IL-33 release. Blocking this pathway reduced ILC2 activation and allergic airway inflammation in mice.

biological.citation: PCBP2 knockdown promotes ferroptosis in malignant mesothelioma (PMID: 35089637)
biological.summary: PCBP2 knockdown, but not PCBP1 knockdown, decreased TfR1 and FTH expression and proliferation in mesothelioma cells. It also increased sensitivity to erastin-induced ferroptosis with increased catalytic Fe(II). Normal rat peritoneal mesothelium lacked PCBP2 immunopositivity, whereas ~90% of rat MM specimens were PCBP1/2 positive.
biological.sample_size: Rat and human MM specimens and cell lines

biological.citation: RNA-binding protein PCBP2 regulates pancreatic β cell function and adaptation to glucose (PMID: 38950317)
biological.summary: PCBP2 is induced by high glucose in mouse and human islets and is downregulated in islets from T2D donors. Pcbp2-deficient β cells showed altered insulin secretory pathway mRNAs, defective calcium flux, abnormal insulin granule ultrastructure and exocytosis, and impaired insulin secretion. PCBP2-affected genes overlapped with T2D-associated SNP-linked genes.

biological.citation: PCBP2 Regulates p16(INK4a)-Dependent Cellular Senescence in Response to Iron (PMID: 41216990)
biological.summary: The atherosclerosis-associated CDKN2A/B functional SNP rs1333046 recruits PCBP2 to regulate p16INK4a and senescence in endothelial cells. PCBP2 also regulates CD40 and NF-κB-driven SASP genes. Iron alters PCBP2 binding to rs1333046, and PCBP2 overexpression restores senescence in cells with reduced labile iron.

biological.citation: PHGDH Inhibits Ferroptosis and Promotes Malignant Progression by Upregulating SLC7A11 in Bladder Cancer (PMID: 36147463)
biological.summary: PHGDH binds PCBP2 (co-IP/mass spectrometry) and inhibits its ubiquitination-mediated degradation. Stabilized PCBP2 then stabilizes SLC7A11 mRNA, increasing SLC7A11 expression and suppressing ferroptosis in bladder cancer.

biological.citation: PCBP2 Mediates Olaparib Resistance in Breast Cancer by Inhibiting m6A Methylation to Stabilize PARP1 mRNA (PMID: 40773674)
biological.summary: PCBP2 is upregulated in olaparib-resistant BRCA-mutated breast cancer cells. PCBP2 overexpression increased resistance. PCBP2 directly binds PARP1 mRNA, inhibits its m6A methylation and stabilizes it, enhancing DNA repair.

biological.citation: PCBP2 Posttranscriptional Modifications Induce Breast Cancer Progression via Upregulation of UFD1 and NT5E (PMID: 33037085)
biological.summary: PCBP2 mRNA and protein levels are discordant in breast cancer. Alternative polyadenylation of the 3'UTR yields shorter transcripts that produce more protein. High PCBP2 protein is associated with progression and poor outcome. PCBP2 knockdown reduced proliferation, migration, invasion, tumor growth and metastasis. PCBP2 binds the 3'UTRs of UFD1 and NT5E to upregulate them.

biological.citation: Pharmacologic inhibition of PCBP2 biomolecular condensates relieves Alzheimer's disease (PMID: 41298370)
biological.summary: PCBP2 is elevated in the brains of AD patients and animal models and correlates with phase-separated condensates. These condensates sequester mitochondrial and mRNA-binding proteins, impair mitochondria, and promote BACE1 mRNA decay. The small molecule CN-0928 binds INTS1, reduces PCBP2 levels, and improves AD pathology and cognition.
